text: Been using this for a couple weeks now, and I really love this app! There's a concept shared across (almost) all these habit tracker apps, which is to allow the user to miss a day or two at a certain cost (streak freezes and needing to buy them, for example). This however punishes the user for not *logging* the habit, as opposed to not *doing* the habit. snakestreak doesn't punish the user for missing a day or two of logging, which keeps the enthusiasm up, which keeps the ball rolling.
author: arii
developer_reply: ​Hi arii, thank you so much for the wonderful feedback and for using snakestreak! It is incredibly rewarding to hear that my design choices resonate with you. I completely agree the focus should be on doing the habit rather than just logging it. Thanks for supporting my app, and I wish you continued success!

text: It's a simple yet engaging habit tracker. As you stay consistent, your snakes grow, which makes building habits fun and motivating. One thing I'd love is a collapsed view, because once you have more than five habits, there's a lot of scrolling. I also think there should be an easy way to contact the developer to report bugs and suggest new features.
author: Aftab Hussain
developer_reply: Thanks for the great review! We're glad the snake mechanic keeps you building habits. A collapsed view for 5+ habits is a stellar idea to save scrolling! For now, please send bug reports and ideas via our website support page at snakestreak.com . We'll look into adding a direct in-app button soon.
